subject: english
title: Letter sounds and short words
canDo: I can hear the sounds in a short word and read words like cat, pig and sun.

subject: english
title: Two letters, one sound: sh, ch, th, ng
titleId: Dua huruf satu bunyi: sh, ch, th, ng
canDo: I can read and spell words with sh, ch, th and ng.

subject: english
title: Vowel teams: ai, ee, igh, oa, oo
titleId: Gabungan vokal ai, ee, igh, oa, dan oo
canDo: I can read words with ai, ee, igh, oa and oo, like rain, tree and boat.

subject: english
title: Tricky words
titleId: Kata sulit yang tidak dibaca sesuai bunyi huruf
canDo: I can read and spell tricky words like the, said, was and they.

subject: english
title: Opposites and word groups
canDo: I can find opposites like hot and cold and put words into groups.

subject: english
title: Capital letters and full stops
canDo: I can start a sentence with a capital letter and end it with a full stop.

subject: english
title: Question marks and exclamation marks
canDo: I can end a question with a question mark and a strong feeling with an exclamation mark.

subject: english
title: Naming, doing and describing words
titleId: Kata benda, kata kerja, dan kata sifat
canDo: I can find naming words, doing words and describing words in a sentence.

subject: english
title: Adding -s, -es and -ing
canDo: I can add -s or -es for more than one, and -ing to a doing word.

subject: english
title: Finding answers in a text
titleId: Mencari informasi dan perasaan tokoh dalam bacaan
canDo: I can find answers in a story or fact text and say how a character feels.

subject: english
title: Story order and kinds of text
titleId: Urutan cerita, menebak kelanjutan, dan jenis teks
canDo: I can put events in order, guess what happens next and tell a story from a fact text.

subject: english
title: Rhyme and poems
canDo: I can hear words that rhyme and talk about a short poem.

subject: english
title: Writing sentences
canDo: I can write a sentence with a capital letter, finger spaces and a full stop.

subject: english
title: Speaking and listening
canDo: I can talk about a picture, tell a short story and read a sentence aloud.
